r13_contract.comparisonModel: However, ships of ice class IA Super or IA the keels of which have been laid or which have been at a similar stage of construction before 1 September 2003 shall comply with the requirements in section 3.2.2 or 3.2.4 of the Ice Class Regulations of 2017 not later than 1 January in the year when twenty years have elapsed since the year the ship was delivered.

test_cases.rationale: Pre-1986 IA ship satisfies the 20-year obligation via section 3.2.2.
Pre-1986 IA Super ship satisfies the obligation via section 3.2.4.
Assessment before the due date is not yet subject to the 20-year method obligation.
IB is outside the IA/IA Super legacy method obligation.
Stage at the 1986-11-01 boundary belongs to the later section-1.6 cohort and is outside TRF-009.
Applicable and due pre-1986 IA ship has no accepted method.
Applicable and due pre-1986 ship records an unsupported method.
Missing delivery date prevents calculation of the 20-year due date.
